hybrid_claim.operational_definition: The principal figure forms a closed or cyclic enclosure and includes an inward-directed indentation, inward turn, or re-entrant attachment in that enclosure.
hybrid_claim.phrase: A cyclic enclosure with an inward re-entrant feature

required_visual_cues.positive_description: The principal marks join or repeat around a bounded interior area to form a closed or cyclic enclosure.
Part of the enclosing figure turns or projects inward toward the bounded interior, creating a visible notch, indentation, or re-entrant attachment.

panel_descriptions.neg_0: A nearly circular closed loop made from changing repeated symbols, with circles along the lower arc, squares along the upper-left arc, and a dense zigzag section along the right arc; the loop follows an outwardly rounded course.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: A small open angular stroke resembling a bent fork or angular animal outline, with separated endpoints on the left.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: A slim open lightning-like angular stroke with pointed turns and separated endpoints toward the right.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: Three patterned arms meet near one junction: a horizontal zigzag arm, a diagonal chain of circles, and a diagonal chain of squares, forming an open branching figure.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: Several patterned open arcs form an arch-like arrangement: triangles on the upper-left arm, zigzags on two side portions, and squares on a curved lower-right arm.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: A long narrow open outline resembling an elongated split wedge, with two separated endpoints on the right.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: A roughly circular arrangement of repeated circles and squares with dark angular connectors; several portions bend inward toward the central area while the marks collectively surround it.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: A single closed rounded outline with a sharp V-shaped indentation entering from the upper-right side.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: A closed curved sector-like shape joined at its pointed side to a small tilted closed quadrilateral, producing an inward re-entrant junction.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: A large tilted closed quadrilateral attached at one corner to a smaller folded triangular outline, creating an inward-pointing re-entrant attachment.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A single closed irregular polygon with a distinct inward-bending vertex on its left side.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: Two very thin closed angular outlines overlap or join, producing a small inward-pointing notch at their left-side junction.

model_payload.positive_description: Each positive panel shows a closed or cyclic enclosure together with a visible feature directed inward into that enclosure.
